/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from PIL import Image
from pathlib import Path
import json, hashlib

def light_neutral_ratio(path, crop=None):
    im=Image.open(path).convert('RGB')
    if crop:
        im=im.crop(crop)
    im.thumbnail((512,512))
    hsv=im.convert('HSV')
    px=list(hsv.getdata())
    # proxy for warm-white / pale neutral negative space
    n=sum(1 for h,s,v in px if s < 50 and v > 220)
    return round(n/len(px),4)

v0=Path('outputs/v0/assets/territory-02-daylight-grain-concept.png')
v1=Path('outputs/v1/assets/territory-02-daylight-grain-refined.png')
print('light_neutral_ratio_overall_v0', light_neutral_ratio(v0))
print('light_neutral_ratio_overall_v1', light_neutral_ratio(v1))
# source sizes are same 1536x1024; left packaging third and middle ecommerce third
print('light_neutral_ratio_packaging_v0', light_neutral_ratio(v0,(0,0,512,1024)))
print('light_neutral_ratio_packaging_v1', light_neutral_ratio(v1,(0,0,512,1024)))
print('light_neutral_ratio_ecom_v0', light_neutral_ratio(v0,(512,0,1024,1024)))
print('light_neutral_ratio_ecom_v1', light_neutral_ratio(v1,(512,0,1024,1024)))
for p in ['outputs/project-state.json','outputs/v0/verification.json']:
    json.loads(Path(p).read_text())
    print('json_valid', p)
for p in ['outputs/v0/01-conflicts-and-10-hypotheses.png','outputs/v0/02-three-creative-territories.png','outputs/v0/assets/territory-02-daylight-grain-concept.png','outputs/v1/assets/territory-02-daylight-grain-refined.png','outputs/v1/01-daylight-grain-v1-refinement-board.png','outputs/v1/refinement-notes.md','outputs/v1/imagegen-prompts.md']:
    q=Path(p)
    print('artifact', p, q.exists(), q.stat().st_size if q.exists() else None, hashlib.sha256(q.read_bytes()).hexdigest() if q.exists() else None)
PY"
